statement: Preregistration only. Selected from GitHub-reviewed advisory metadata and commit-only fetches (commit objects, no trees, no blobs). No fix diff, source file, scan, SARIF, score or detector/rule output was read for any Q3 case.

target.note: Every advisory that qualified under the Q2 rules was taken; no ecosystem cap was applied, as in Q2. The pool is small because the July-October 2026 advisories were already spent by the fresh (Jul-Aug), 20261123, overflow and Sep-Oct cohorts (400 prior-ID drops).

requested_api.result: HTTP 403 from the session proxy for all six queries: "This GitHub API path is not available: sessions are bound to their configured repositories." No advisory data was returned.

used.fetch: git fetch --depth=1 --filter=blob:none origin main, then sparse checkout of advisories/github-reviewed/2026/{07,08,09,10,11}/ (OSV JSON metadata only).
used.rationale: This repository is the published source of the GitHub-reviewed global advisories that the REST API serves, and it is the source Q2 was frozen from (commit 2b08e25f: "selected by recall_harness freeze from github/advisory-database metadata only").

equivalent_filters.type_reviewed: path advisories/github-reviewed/ and database_specific.github_reviewed == true; withdrawn records excluded
equivalent_filters.ecosystem: ecosystem of the first affected package in Maven, PyPI, Go, npm, Packagist or RubyGems
equivalent_filters.published: published[:10] >= 2026-07-01 (strictly after the latest Q2 publication date, 2026-06-30) and <= 2026-11-25 (latest publication date in the snapshot)

q2_rule_check.purpose: Q2 plan does not spell out the fix-commit rule, so it was derived from Q2's own advisory metadata (advisory JSON only, 2026/04-06, same snapshot).
findings: All 282 Q2 fixes are the first https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>/commit/<40-hex> reference of their advisory.
281 of 282 Q2 advisories have exactly one distinct full-SHA https commit reference; the remaining one (GHSA-72r4-9c5j-mj57) has a second reference only as http://, which Q2 did not count.
Abbreviated-SHA commit links were ignored (GHSA-2fp4-5v5c-4448, GHSA-g2xq-2v27-4rh3); a #diff fragment was accepted (GHSA-m8mh-x359-vm8m).
None of the 72 in-window, in-family, six-ecosystem advisories with two or more distinct full-SHA https commit references was selected in Q2.
q2_rule_check.rule_applied: Exactly one distinct 40-hex SHA among references matching ^https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>/commit/<sha>(#...)?$; repository is that reference's owner/repo. Then recall_harness freeze: CWE family (FAMILIES map), prior advisory ID, prior fix SHA, one case per fix, at most 3 per repository (--per-repo 3), newest first; no per-ecosystem cap.

freeze.command: node scripts/recall_harness.mjs freeze --candidates q3-candidates.json --from 2026-07-01 --to 2026-11-25 --out heldout-recall-manifest-20261126-q3.json --exclude-dir docs/evidence --exclude-dir <prior-extra> --per-repo 3
freeze.harness: Run with scripts/recall_harness.mjs at the worktree head (origin/claude/carry-forward-39 e1cb77ca) and with the pinned bytes at 52eb74dc (recall_harness.mjs sha256 a4e4ddd4...); both outputs are byte-identical. validateRecallManifest and caseDigest were imported from the harness and agree with cases_sha256.

candidate_metadata.definition: GitHub-reviewed, non-withdrawn advisories published 2026-07-01..2026-11-25 in the six ecosystems with exactly one canonical fix commit (fields ghsa, ecosystem, cwes, published, repository, fix). Not committed, as in Q2; reproducible from the advisory-database commit above.

exclusions.method: recall_harness priorExposure(): every GHSA ID and 40-hex SHA in any JSON under docs/evidence of claude/carry-forward-39 (e1cb77ca), plus the extra files below. Q2 used the same method (556 IDs, 1,288 fixes at its freeze).

extra_files.note: Jul-Aug fresh cohort (91), not present on carry-forward-39

drop_counts.note: prefilter counts cover every record in the snapshot window; *_in_family counts are the ones that would otherwise have reached the CWE-family stage. multi_ecosystem records were kept with the first affected six-ecosystem package.

drops.fix_commit_note: Only drops whose CWEs are in the scoring families are listed individually; the others would have been dropped as family anyway and are counted in prefilter.

fetch_verification.method: Per candidate: git init in a fresh temporary directory; git fetch --no-tags --filter=tree:0 --depth=2 https://github.com/<repository> <fix>; record object type and parents; rm -rf immediately. No tree or blob was fetched, nothing checked out.
fetch_verification.scope: All candidates that passed the window, family, prior-ID and prior-fix stages (before the per-fix and per-repository stages), so an unresolvable fix could not take a repository slot.
